subject: Security compliance discovery: SOC 2 status & roadmap (MedicaHealth)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alan Weiss <alan.weiss@medicahealth.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@medicahealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — SOC 2 / HIPAA / vendor questionnaire

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth:

- Current environment: you mentioned MedicaHealth is evaluating LLM-powered triage assistants and would like to understand data residency, audit logs, and PHI handling.
- Compliance drivers: HIPAA applicability for patient data, SOC 2 as procurement requirement for some lines of business, and interest in a roadmap that could include ISO 27001 or FedRAMP down the line.

Our asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm current SOC 2 posture (Type I vs Type II) and the expected completion date if in progress?
2) Is HIPAA in-scope for the workloads you plan to run on Redwood? Any particular BAAs or data-flow diagrams we should expect?
3) We'll send our vendor security questionnaire (short PDF) — could your security team fill and return? We can also prefill parts to save time.
4) Proposing a technical deep-dive next week to walk through encryption, key management (KMS/HSM), and audit log exports. Suggested slots: Tue/Wed 10–12 PT.

I'll attach the questionnaire and a preliminary compliance roadmap template that sketches timelines for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 scoping, and longer-term FedRAMP conversations.

If you'd prefer one consolidated doc instead of multiple threads I can upload to a shared Drive link.

Thanks — looking forward to coordinating.

–Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (pdf), Prelim-Compliance-Roadmap.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Alan Weiss <alan.weiss@medicahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@medicahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — SOC 2 / HIPAA / vendor questionnaire

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and the clear next steps. A few quick answers from our side:

- SOC 2: We completed SOC 2 Type I in 2025 and are currently in the middle of our Type II engagement; the audit window closes end of Q3 2027 (tentative).
- HIPAA: Yes, HIPAA is in-scope for the patient-facing triage use case. We already have BAAs in place with a handful of vendors, but we'll need to review Redwood's controls and logging to finalize.
- We're happy to complete your vendor questionnaire — Priya will take lead. I'll also attach our internal security overview (top-level) for context.

Priya — can you please coordinate on timeline for returning the questionnaire? Ideally within one week so we can keep the procurement timeline moving.

Alan
Director, IT Security
MedicaHealth

Attachments: MedicaHealth-Security-Overview.pdf (pdf)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the materials. Priya here from MedicaHealth security. We'll start on the questionnaire today. A couple of clarifying points so your team can prepare answers for the technical call:

- For HIPAA in-scope workloads: we need details on where PHI will be stored (hosted vs customer-managed VPC), retention/default deletion behavior, and exportability of audit logs for audits.
- For SOC 2: any current reports/redlines you can share (control mappings) would help us map gaps.

I'll aim to return the completed vendor questionnaire by next Wednesday EOD. Also please send a calendar invite for the technical deep-dive (Alan and I prefer Wed 10am PT).

Thanks — Priya
